description: A small stack of colorful chunky Lego-style blocks sits on the bed in front of the pillow. The left hand comes in to steady the stack while the right hand lifts off the green block upward and sets it to the right, then removes a red block and places it nearby; next the right hand pulls off the yellow block, separates the remaining blue and white pieces, and spreads the loose blocks out on the bed while the left hand holds and then releases the base.
